# Source Dossier Template

```yaml
---
source_id: <slug>
source_type: model-tr | open-project | model-card | blog-bundle | external-eval
org: <org>
release_date: <YYYY-MM-DD | unknown>
priority: S | A | B | C
status: stub | intake | section-notes | lens-ready | compared
openness: open-weights | fully-open | api-only | unclear
confidence: low | medium | high
lineage: <optional model family / major lineage>
role: full-tr | major-release | release-delta | external-eval | unknown
base_source: <optional source id or TR label this source builds on>
---
```

## 一句话

一句 source-level verdict，不写 intake 占位。
